title: Who, and How Many
label: ch:mr-who-how-many
canDo: I can ask which person is meant with koṇ and ask for a quantity with kitī, and I can say what shape of answer each of the k- asking words wants.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R37-who-how-many and sort three asking words by the shape of the answer they demand: a thing, a person, a number.
payoff.note: The chapter's payoff is the SORT, not the two new words: kāy was already taught and only becomes a system once it has siblings.
